reuse.why: Instead of introducing or reusing one category-selection definition for month-wide actions, each action gets its own goal_def condition, and setZero copies the hidden-filter SQL from the average actions.

duplication.why: The 'skip hidden, hidden-group and templated categories' rule is now spelled out at five sites (four identical SQL WHERE clauses plus a JS check in copyPreviousMonth).

placement.why: Changes stay in budget/actions.ts where these actions live, though the rule is embedded in raw SQL per action rather than a helper.

scope.why: Focused on month-wide actions plus a test; the getBudgetData return-type change is a small incidental edit.

maintainability.why: Any future change to which categories month-wide actions may write requires editing five scattered SQL/JS conditions that already diverge in form.

one_place.where: Rule added separately in copyPreviousMonth (JS check), setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg (SQL WHERE clauses) in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts
